description: Enforce database-level access control by assigning each application service a dedicated database account with GRANT-limited permissions. App accounts receive only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on specific tables — never CREATE, DROP, ALTER, GRANT, or DBA/superuser roles. Prevents SQL injection from escalating to schema modification, cross-database access, or OS command execution via xp_cmdshell/COPY/LOAD_FILE. Each microservice or application component should use a separate credential with the minimum privilege set required for its operations.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: SQL injection cannot exfiltrate data from other databases or tables outside the app account's GRANT scope; UNION-based extraction is limited to the account's SELECT privileges
Cannot modify schema, drop tables, or alter other services' data; DML limited to explicitly GRANTed tables

verification.method: Verify application database accounts have no superuser, DDL, or GRANT privileges

commands.command: psql -h localhost -U <app_user> -c "SELECT rolsuper, rolcreatedb, rolcreaterole FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='<app_user>'"
psql -h localhost -U <app_user> -c "SELECT grantor, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE grantee='<app_user>'" | grep -iE 'create|drop|alter|grant'

Invoke-Sqlcmd -Query "SELECT dp.permission_name FROM sys.database_permissions dp JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON dp.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id WHERE pr.name = '<app_user>' AND dp.permission_name IN ('ALTER','CREATE','CONTROL')"
mysql -h localhost -u <app_user> -e "SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER()" | grep -iE 'ALL PRIVILEGES|SUPER|CREATE|DROP|ALTER|GRANT'

remediation.name: PostgreSQL dedicated application user with DML-only grants

steps.description: Create a dedicated application database user with no superuser, createdb, or createrole privileges; uses CREATE/ALTER pattern for idempotency
steps.command: psql -h localhost -U postgres -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '<app_user>') THEN CREATE USER <app_user> WITH PASSWORD '<password>' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE; END IF; END \$\$;"

steps.description: Grant only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on application tables in the target schema; no DDL or GRANT privileges
steps.command: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d <database> -c "GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA <schema> TO <app_user>; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA <schema> GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO <app_user>;"
steps.undo: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d <database> -c "REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA <schema> FROM <app_user>;"

steps.description: Revoke CREATE privilege on public schema from PUBLIC role to prevent the application user from creating new tables
steps.command: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d <database> -c "REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;"
steps.undo: psql -h localhost -U postgres -d <database> -c "GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO PUBLIC;"

remediation.verify: psql -h localhost -U <app_user> -d <database> -c "SELECT rolsuper, rolcreatedb, rolcreaterole FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='<app_user>'"

remediation.name: MySQL dedicated application user with DML-only grants

steps.description: Create a dedicated application database user restricted to localhost connections
steps.command: mysql -u root -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '<app_user>'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '<password>';"

steps.description: Grant only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on the application database; no DDL, GRANT, or SUPER privileges
steps.command: mysql -u root -e "GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON <database>.* TO '<app_user>'@'localhost';"
steps.undo: mysql -u root -e "REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON <database>.* FROM '<app_user>'@'localhost';"

steps.description: Reload grant tables to ensure privilege changes take effect immediately

remediation.verify: mysql -u <app_user> -e "SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER()" | grep -iE 'ALL PRIVILEGES|SUPER|CREATE|DROP|ALTER|GRANT'
